before.title: Big Five add-on: high neuroticism amplifies context shifts
before.body: Your Big Five result points to higher neuroticism, which can intensify how MBTI context-sensitive stability feels in daily life. The useful read is not to question the type itself, but to create recovery room, lower-friction pacing, and emotional buffering earlier.
